    verify_inputs(out, inputs, inputs_sha256, ReadSet())

    command = ['C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/sh.exe', wrapper.as_posix(), 'kicad', str(NATIVE_BINARIES['native_python']), str(STAGE / 'C:\\Users\\Gluis\\OneDrive\\Documents\\ChatGPT\\Controller\\reports\\board-finish-20261011\\continuation-r2\\native_entry_width_r3.py'), str(PARSER), str(out / 'native-via-spec.json'), (out / 'parity-copy/board.kicad_pcb').as_posix(), '--netlist', (out / 'source/sch.net').as_posix(), '--no-connectivity', '--examples', '40', (out / 'native-parity-r3.json').as_posix()]
